title: "FLIP daily diary data"
output: html_document
---

## Participants and recorded observations

```{r real-data-inventory}
flip_path <- file.path("flip", "0002_nestler_ts.tsv")
flip <- read.delim(flip_path, check.names = FALSE)
flip_variables <- c("sociable", "creative", "friendly", "organised",
                    "self_esteem", "nervous")
flip_counts <- table(flip$id)
days_by_participant <- split(flip$day, flip$id)
flip_complete_82 <- sum(vapply(days_by_participant, function(days) {
  all(seq_len(82) %in% days)
}, logical(1)))
flip_n <- nrow(flip)
flip_k <- length(flip_counts)
flip_duplicate_keys <- sum(duplicated(flip[c("id", "day", "beep")]))
flip_incomplete <- sum(!complete.cases(flip[flip_variables]))
```

| Inventory item | Result |
|:--|--:|
| Participants | `r flip_k` |
| Recorded observations | `r format(flip_n, big.mark = ",")` |
| Observations per participant (minimum / median / maximum) | `r min(flip_counts)` / `r median(as.numeric(flip_counts))` / `r max(flip_counts)` |
| First and last recorded study day | `r min(flip$day)` to `r max(flip$day)` |
| Participants with a record on every study day from 1 through 82 | `r flip_complete_82` |
| Rows repeating an earlier participant/day | `r flip_duplicate_keys` |
| Recorded rows missing at least one of the six ratings | `r flip_incomplete` |
